title: EventLens: Event-Structure Reinforcement Learning for Video Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2610.16172v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong results on video question answering, yet often fail to recover the temporal structure that makes a video coherent. They may merge neighboring events, miss single-event progression, or infer implausible relations across events. We study structured temporal understanding as the ability to recover event structure from visual evidence, including event boundaries, single-event progression, and multi-event relations. We argue that this gap arises from a mismatch between current post-training objectives and temporal reasoning, where caption-style supervision allows models to rely on language shortcuts rather than visual temporal grounding. To address this, we propose EventLens, a vision-centric reinforcement learning framework that learns video understanding through event-structure recovery. Instead of reconstructing captions, EventLens trains models to recover temporal structure

translated_title: EventLens：面向视频理解的事件结构强化学习
translated_abstract: 近期的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视频问答任务上取得了出色的成绩，但往往无法恢复使视频保持连贯的时间结构。它们可能将相邻事件合并在一起、遗漏单一事件的进展过程，或推断出事件之间不合理的关系。我们研究结构化时间理解，即从视觉证据中恢复事件结构的能力，包括事件边界、单事件进展以及多事件关系。我们认为，这一差距源于当前后训练目标与时间推理之间的不匹配——字幕式的监督使模型能够依赖语言捷径，而非进行视觉层面的时间定位。为解决这一问题，我们提出了EventLens，一个以视觉为中心、通过事件结构恢复来学习视频理解的强化学习框架。EventLens不再重建字幕，而是训练模型去恢复时间结构
tldr: 提出EventLens，一个以视觉为中心的强化学习框架，通过训练模型从视觉证据中恢复事件结构（包括事件边界、单事件进展和多事件关系），而非依赖字幕式语言捷径，从而提升多模态大语言模型对视频时间结构的理解能力。
en_tdlr: EventLens is a vision-centric reinforcement learning framework that enhances video understanding in MLLMs by training models to recover event structure—event boundaries, single-event progression, and multi-event relations—from visual evidence, rather than relying on caption-style language shortcuts.
